BusinessModel: Runs a wallet and payments app. Consumers pay bills, recharge and pay shops through it. Earns fees from merchants and from arranging small loans via partner banks.
RevenueStreams: Payments services ~75% and credit (ZIP) ~20% plus other ~5% (FY24 DRHP mix); FY25 total revenue Rs 1170 cr
Expenses: Payment processing and marketing costs dominate; borrowings Rs 276 cr (FY25) with interest ~Rs 25 cr; no raw materials
TAM: India digital payments US$3 trillion+ transaction value (FY24 industry reports); exact TAM data not found
PL_Top3_Contributors: Payment services fees; credit (ZIP) take rates; cost discipline swing (FY25 loss Rs 122 cr)

BusinessModel: Owns hotels across India and pays Marriott, Hyatt and IHG to run them. Earns from guest rooms, food and beverage, and banquets.
RevenueStreams: Room revenue ~70-75% (FY25); F&B ~20-25%; other ~5%; FY25 revenue Rs 1123 cr, FY26 Rs 1248 cr
Expenses: Rooms and F&B operating costs; interest Rs ~151 cr (FY26) down from ~Rs 346 cr (FY4); depreciation ~Rs 118 cr FY26
TAM: India branded hotel room supply, few lakh rooms; RevPAR growing low-teens (FY25 company presentations)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Room revenue growth (RevPAR +12-16% FY25); falling finance costs; AC Hotels portfolio (962 rooms) ramp-up

BusinessModel: Sells steel products through stockyards across Eastern India. Fabricates pre-engineered buildings and girders, distributes tractor engines and spares, and makes PVC pipes (BMW Polytube).
RevenueStreams: Steel distribution bulk of revenue (FY26 total Rs 2279 cr); fabrication, tractor parts and PVC pipes smaller (split data not found)
Expenses: Cost of steel ~95% of sales (OPM 3-4% FY26); interest ~Rs 28 cr FY26; thin all-in cost structure
TAM: India steel consumption 150+ million tonnes (industry estimates); PEB market thousands of crores
PL_Top3_Contributors: Steel price spread; fabricated steel/PEB volumes; interest and working-capital cost

BusinessModel: Makes exhaust and clean-air systems, powertrain parts and aftermarket ride products for Indian vehicle makers. Also exports to Tenneco's global plants.
RevenueStreams: Clean Air & Powertrain and ART aftermarket segments (FY26 revenue Rs 5405 cr, +10.5%); segment split data not found
Expenses: Raw materials (steel, substrates) largest; employee and other costs; interest only ~Rs 30 cr FY26
TAM: India auto components US$70-80 billion (ACMA estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: OEM volumes (car/commercial cycle); ART aftermarket margins; exports and new emissions-tech content

BusinessModel: Makes steel pipes and tubes - ERW black, galvanised, hollow sections and primer-painted pipes - at plants in Maharashtra and Andhra. Sells mainly to pipe brands with Jindal Pipes as key customer.
RevenueStreams: Pipes and tubes ~100% (FY26 revenue Rs 1151 cr); product-wise split data not found
Expenses: Raw material (HR coil) ~95% of sales (OPM 3-5%); interest ~Rs 15 cr FY26; depreciation ~Rs 17 cr FY26
TAM: India steel tubes and pipes market, thousands of crores (industry estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Conversion spread over coil cost; Jindal Pipes volumes; freight and interest costs

BusinessModel: Builds packaging machines - vertical and horizontal form-fill-seal bag-making lines - plus spares and service. Sells in India and exports worldwide under the Mamata brand.
RevenueStreams: Machines bulk, spares and service minority (FY25 revenue Rs 255 cr; FY26 Rs 233 cr); exports a majority per DRHP coverage, exact split data not found
Expenses: Raw materials and bought-out components dominate; employee costs modest; near debt-free with interest under Rs 1 cr
TAM: Global packaging machinery US$50+ billion (industry estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Machine sales timing (lumpy quarters); export orders at higher margin; spares and service annuity

BusinessModel: Lends to consumers, shops and homebuyers through its app and the Relatio ecosystem. Also runs insurance broking, payments and an asset-management JV with BlackRock.
RevenueStreams: Interest income from lending (FY26 total income Rs 3513 cr); treasury and investment income; fee income from insurance/payments; AMC JV
Expenses: Interest cost ~Rs 900 cr FY26 (rising with loan book); operating expenses ~Rs 1410 cr FY26
TAM: India retail credit, tens of lakh crores; digital lending growing 20%+ p.a. (RBI/industry estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Net interest income vs borrowing costs; treasury/investment income (Sep-quarter one-offs); new verticals scaling (insurance, AMC)

BusinessModel: Builds and sells homes in South Mumbai and redevelops old buildings. Also develops business parks on the city periphery.
RevenueStreams: Residential sales bulk; redevelopment and periphery business parks rest (FY25 revenue Rs 549 cr; FY26 Rs 556 cr); split data not found
Expenses: Construction cost largest; finance cost ~Rs 80-90 cr FY26 falling from FY4; approvals and marketing costs
TAM: Mumbai residential market plus island-city redevelopment pipeline worth tens of thousands of crores (industry estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: South Mumbai project completions (lumpy); redevelopment/SRA projects margin; falling finance costs

BusinessModel: Runs mobile phone and home-broadband services in the Rajasthan and North-East circles as a Bharti Airtel subsidiary. Customers pay monthly tariffs for calls and data.
RevenueStreams: Mobile services ~85-90% (FY26 revenue Rs 9354 cr); home broadband rest; split data not found
Expenses: Network and spectrum costs (depreciation ~Rs 2200+ cr FY26); interest ~Rs 620 cr FY26; employee and licence fees
TAM: India telecom services roughly Rs 2.5+ lakh crore annually (TRAI/industry estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Tariff hikes in a 2-3 player market; subscriber mix-up to higher ARPU; home broadband cross-sell

Company: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Ltd
BusinessModel: Government-owned lender that gives loans for solar, wind, hydro and other green-energy projects. Earns the spread between lending yields and its own borrowing cost.
RevenueStreams: Interest income on renewable loans ~all (FY25 revenue Rs 6743 cr; FY26 Rs 8310 cr); fee income minor
Expenses: Interest cost ~Rs 5000+ cr FY26 (largest head); provisions (Jun-25 quarter spike); operating expenses ~Rs 1000+ cr FY26
TAM: India renewable investment US$30-35 billion+ per year toward 500 GW by 2030 (government estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Loan book growth ~20%+; cost of funds spreads; asset quality (provision spikes)
